metadata.title: Clicked like a confused squirrel, somehow got 2 kills? Valorant logic broke again!
metadata.description:
Me: just smashing buttons without a clue
Enemy: probably rethinking their entire life
Valorant: handing out 2 kills like it’s a lottery
If your aim’s a mess but kills come anyway, you know the feeling

Tap if your best kills are pure chaos too!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckykills #funnygaming #shorts
